title: register-client input
description: Create or update the calling module's OIDC client for a bound NS8 user domain. The client ID is the module ID.

domain.description: User domain of the realm. The calling module must be bound to it

redirect_uris.description: Redirect URIs of the authorization code flow. Without redirect URIs the client can only authenticate its own requests, for example token introspection

post_logout_redirect_uris.description: URIs where the logout redirects the user. Applications should pass their exact logout URI. If the attribute is missing, a wildcard URI for each origin of the redirect URIs is set, like https://cloud.example.org/*; an empty list allows none

audience.description: Client IDs added to the audience of the tokens, for example the mail module whose Dovecot introspects them

rotate_secret.description: Generate a new client secret. Otherwise the current secret is returned

module_id.description: Module that owns the client. Allowed only for tasks without a calling user, for example created by the cluster agent: otherwise the owner is the calling module
